products.summary: 8MiB Flash / 8MiB PSRAM。精确SKU数字外设子集。

sources.title: Official exact SKU/options and manufacturer product description
Original legacy RGB example bundle; exceeds browser archive bounds

limitations: No complete exact factory image found in inspected sources. Legacy LCD RGB ZIP has separate build components and exceeds every bounded ZIP loader limit.
Partial source-bounded digital simulation. Physical hardware, complete original factory applications and browser/WebGL acceptance are not claimed.
Bare board has no display/touch. RGB kits480x480: CST820@15 for2.1; GT911@14/5d for2.8/4. TCA20 SDA15/SCL7,P0touchreset/P1BLenable/P2LCDreset,GPIO42CS/2SCLK/1MOSI.
No onboard RTC/IMU/TF. GPIO6 backlight uses AP3032 feedback injection; inverse duty is normalized display policy, not calibrated analog brightness.

541714255-byte legacy ZIP,26972entries,2329844170expandedbytes exceeds all browser archive limits. Complete separate files were inspected for evidence without remerging/rebuilding firmware or relaxing limits.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
No board-level layout/CAD is supplied by the inspected exact-family sources. Photo-visible component envelopes remain approximate; unknown PCB surfaces are explicitly marked UNKNOWN.
Assembly groups preserve soldered or fixed components with their carrier; kit contents without a documented mounted pose use an explicitly staged inspection layout, not a physical installation claim.
No enclosure is part of these SKUs. Separate RGB modules are shown as kit contents; optional battery and external18-pin SPI displays are not added.
